post_native_path_screen.scope: Posthoc samples, including each initial state; no continuous-time clearance or collision-response proof. Native robot self-collision remains disabled.

route_observation.scope: Canonical controller observations on one exposed route body. Model requests and prepared response are not measured contact reaction or causal isolation.

interpretation: At the clean pushed source freeze, 278 safety controls passed before both native owners. Twelve six-second full-capture route worlds covered seeking, measured contact acquisition, retained-support loading, positive staged unloading and bounded fallback before the 192-world broad cohort.

The broad cohort used 24 exposed body shapes, four support-sharing variants and four fresh comparators per body. All 192 twelve-second worlds were valid recovery failures with zero upright dwell, zero joint-limit violations and zero declared progress leads. All 24 recovery shortlists are empty.

Of 96 new-controller worlds, 47 had positive peak-rotation gain against their fresh selected reference and 43 exceeded their fresh failed-exchange comparator. The maximum selected-reference gain was 2.9623419425064963 degrees, below the unchanged five-degree threshold. These exposed descriptive comparisons do not establish recovery benefit.

One full-route sameend_shared_drive2_axis0_r07 event completed 36 transfer intervals while retaining required contact. Rotation decreased from 23.458783231818305 to 22.924768919177033 degrees during that transfer. Its overall route peak remained below the fresh selected reference. A completed transfer is a code-path observation on one exposed body, not a useful recovery controller or an isolated explanation of the broad failures.

Full-route replay verified 8640 controller decisions and 43200 native samples. Broad compact verification checked 276480 controller records and reconstructed 1382400 native samples; it does not replay full controller decisions or detailed native forces.

The retained-path screen selected zero trajectories because the declared progress shortlist was empty. It opened zero worlds and checked zero motion samples; this is not evidence that all cohort paths are clear. Native robot self-collision remains disabled.

All 24 body-shape and model-XML bindings match the predecessor cohort, with fresh worlds and comparators. Family-level means and the exposed failed-exchange comparator selection are descriptive, not held-out adaptation or a trained selector.

Thirteen completed righting performance cohorts now retain 2896 valid recovery failures, excluding route worlds. No controller is adopted. Recovery, useful online correction, learned selection, Studio recovery handoff, real-time operation and release remain unqualified.
Native worker and owner timings are retained without a matched performance comparison. This run does not measure Studio startup or establish a throughput improvement.
next_gate: Diagnose the retained full-capture support-sharing route: compare prepared requests, applied native actuator torque, measured contact continuity and body rotation through loading, unloading and the completed transfer, alongside its fresh reference. Distinguish missing actuator response from missing useful body moment without treating requested contact force as measured ground reaction. Declare a mechanically distinct broad successor only after identifying a testable gap; preserve unchanged limits, the five-degree progress threshold, retained-path screening and fresh full-capture varied-start confirmation for useful leads.
